description.value: Della's Coffee Shop & Grocery sits at Sproat Lake Landing on Vancouver Island, positioned as the midpoint stop on the popular route between Nanaimo and Tofino/Ucluelet. The café offers espresso drinks, fresh-baked pastries, handmade tacos (seasonal), artisanal paninis, grab-and-go fruit and veggie trays, and over 20 flavours of ice cream. It doubles as a small grocery for the local community, stocking staples and household items alongside a picnic area for travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sproatlakelanding.com/dellascafe/ confirms an active café and grocery shop at Sproat Lake Landing resort, described as the halfway point on the Tofino/Nanaimo corridor. The OSM name 'Dellas Café' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Della's Coffee Shop & Grocery', which is flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout is supported by explicit 'grab & go' references and a mentioned picnic area.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Dellas Café' but the website consistently uses 'Della's Coffee Shop & Grocery' throughout all pages.
No address or phone number available in OSM or extractable from the website content provided.
The business is a sub-component of the Sproat Lake Landing resort; the OSM node may underrepresent the full context of the stop.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This café-grocery is the only notable food stop at Sproat Lake on a high-traffic cycling corridor between Nanaimo and Tofino; it would be a practical and valuable listing for touring cyclists despite limited amenity confirmation.
